queries: OpenAI Operator review hands-on tested February 2025 struggled tasks

sources_considered.why: OpenAI's own launch post with benchmark scores and per-task trial success rates for Operator.
Independent roundup of early user tests from the period.
July 2025, outside the target period. It notes the Operator preview site would be sunset; context only.

receipt.public_excerpt: As with any early-stage technology, we don’t expect CUA to perform reliably in all scenarios just yet.

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI itself said the model behind Operator was not yet reliable across scenarios and released it only as a research preview, which supports 'not consistently' and 'not ready for prime time'.

receipt.public_excerpt: OSWorld⁠(opens in a new window) is a benchmark that evaluates models’ ability to control full operating systems like Ubuntu, Windows, and macOS. In this benchmark, CUA achieves 38.1% success rate.

evidence_items.explanation: On full computer-control tasks, the model succeeded only 38.1% of the time, against 72.4% for humans on the same page. That directly supports 'does not appear to be able to do so consistently'.

receipt.public_excerpt: However, it still makes too many mistakes for human users to rely on it for important tasks without constant supervision.

evidence_items.explanation: An independent roundup of early user tests found Operator too error-prone to rely on without constant supervision, which supports 'not ready for prime time'.

receipt.public_excerpt: CUA achieved a 58.1% success rate on WebArena and an 87% success rate on WebVoyager for web-based tasks.

evidence_items.explanation: On simpler web tasks the model succeeded 87% of the time, and some trials on the same page were 10 out of 10. This cuts against the strongest wording, 'barely works', though not against 'not consistently'.

unresolved_gaps: No large independent task-success study of the launch version of Operator was found; the hands-on evidence is a roundup of individual user reports.
The market claim is opinion and was not tested.
